title: Valerie Ransone arrives at Lab Nine

tellings.quote: like channel information. And so she somehow wound up at Puharich's lab, lab nine in in '78.

plain: In 1978, a woman named Valerie Ransone, who was said to be able to "channel information" from beyond herself, ended up at Lab Nine, a research lab run by a man named Puharich that worked on contact of this kind. An unnamed researcher tells Michels this on the show, without saying where it comes from, as the start of how she joined the group.
